verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents a single send endpoint for asynchronous transactional email that returns an `x-message-id` for status tracking. It also offers official libraries as the easiest integration path, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: documentation of the minimal required request fields, explicit copy-paste quickstart code samples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a transactional email with one documented API call — minimal required fields, copy-paste quickstart code, and a message id back for tracking

citations.quote: This endpoint allows you to send an asynchronous email.
It returns the status of the email sent with an `x-message-id` that can be used to continuously query for the status using the Email API.
This is the easiest way to integrate MailerSend with your application.
transactional emails can be sent through MailerSend’s Email API or using SMTP relay.
